Name: Dizor's Seasonal Wizard - Vanilla and SVE
Author: AzraelTT
Description:
[u]I AM NOT A NATIVE ENGLISH SPEAKER SO MAIBE THERE WILL BE SOMES GRAMMAR MISTAKES.[/u]



I am playing my game with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url],  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]﻿ for a long time and personally dont like the vanilla-like portraits of the Wizard﻿...

But for some reason the portraits that we have for him either are a ''pretty boy'' version of him (Cute, but I personally think that it does not fit in his character) , a non seasonal portrait or non SVE version of the portrait.

I reealy liked the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5710]Dizor's Wizard Redraw[/url] portrait but sadly there was no seasonal version, no SVE version and, of course, no SVE seasonal version either.

So I decided to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/653]Dizor's Wizard Redraw Meets Siv's Marriage Mod[/url] version to make an SVE version and then make a seasonal SVE version.

There are 2 versions: One for the Vanilla WIzard (in case you dont use SVE) and other for the SVE Wizard



﻿
[size=6][b][i][u]Instalation:
[/u][/i][/b][/size]
1- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿ and, if you use SVE [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url] as well.
2- Extract the .rar file in the mod paste overriding the assets paste.
3- Click in ﻿""Override all Archives.""
                     DONE
